A Note From the Atelier

I have been
thinking about
your design.

When a commission comes to me, I don't simply open a design file. I sit with it. I research the recipient. I think about what they deserve to see every morning when they enter their space — what feeling should greet them, what memory should be awakened.

For your person, I believe the most powerful design language is the Lamp of Knowledge — a timeless symbol of illumination, wisdom, and the light that one person carries for another. Rendered in layered acrylic with rose quartz inlay, it becomes more than décor. It becomes devotion, made visible.

What I need from you now is simple: a song she would recognize immediately. A melody that lives between the two of you. Because this piece will carry her voice into the room — every time she walks past it, she will feel you there.

The Design Concept

The Lamp
of Knowledge

In cultures spanning millennia, the lamp has represented wisdom, guidance, and the light one soul carries for another. It is the oldest metaphor for love that illuminates — for the friend who lights the room simply by entering it.

As the silhouette of this commission, it will be cut in precision layered acrylic, kissed with rose quartz, and embedded with the technology to carry her voice — or your favorite shared song — inside it permanently.

🎵 What I Need From You
To complete this commission, I will need one of the following:

Option A — A Song
A melody that immediately takes her back to you. When she taps the sign, that song plays.

Option B — A Voice Message
Record anything — a birthday wish, a memory, a message she can hear every morning. Your voice, preserved in the piece forever.

Both options are embedded via NFC chip and are fully downloadable and replaceable at any time.
Premium Materials

What goes
inside the piece.

White Rose Quartz
The stone of unconditional love. Ethically sourced natural rose quartz pressed into the layered composition — not decorative, but intentional. The recipient will feel it when they touch the piece.
Premium Layered Acrylic
Multiple sheets of cast acrylic — frosted, clear, and mirrored — precision-cut and assembled in dimensional layers that create depth, shadow, and movement with the light.
NFC Sound Chip
Embedded invisibly into the piece. One tap with any smartphone plays the chosen song or voice message. No app required. No batteries. Simply — magic.
Gold or Black Mirror Acrylic
The finish layer — your choice. Gold mirror for warmth and radiance. Black mirror for dramatic editorial elegance. Both are premium optical-grade materials.
"No matter what, this sign is going to make her think of you — and just how much she is loved."
